title: KHR_character_expression glTF Document Extension
description: Associates character-expression entries with animations used as normalized, stateless response curves.

expressions.description: Nonempty array of expression entries. Array indices are the authoritative entry identities; labels are not required to be unique.

items.description: One labeled expression driver and its response animation.

expression.description: Nonempty descriptive label for this expression entry.
expression.gltf_detailedDescription: This label is not required to be unique. Consumers MUST use the entry's array index, rather than assuming this value is unique, when an index-based extension refers to the entry.

animation.description: Index of the animation used as this entry's expression response curve.
animation.gltf_detailedDescription: This value MUST be a valid index into the top-level `animations` array. Every channel of that animation participates in the base expression evaluator.
